title: Simultaneous Cochlear Implantation During Translabyrinthine Resection of Vestibular Schwannoma
brief_summary: This study will address the feasibility of simultaneous cochlear implantation during resection of a vestibular schwannoma.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with a vestibular schwannoma undergoing a translabyrinthine resection with intact hearing in the contralateral ear

Exclusion Criteria:

\-
